specification.title: GPAC × REMAG: Physics-Guided Autonomous Crystal Discovery — Development Specification v3.0
specification.source: Owner attachment; line spans are one-based in the original text

interpretation.scope_policy: Examples are not an exhaustive mandatory feature list. Conditional/optional/long-term work is not silently promoted to an initial success gate. Empirical success remains distinct from software delivery.
interpretation.historical_prediction_evidence: Independent prospective REMAG comparisons already exist. They are finite evidence, not a full paired autonomous study or a verified mechanism.
interpretation.no_completion_percentage: Requirement groups differ in scope; counts would not measure completion.

requirements.requirement: Unified mechanism-oriented research environment spanning structure, physics and research memory.
requirements.delivered: Exact authoring, source-bound native queries, saved diagnostics, notebooks and bounded external-policy sessions are integrated. The current chat also directly invokes the extensible tool host without a separate policy service.
requirements.outstanding: Full live-model research quality and scientific advantage are not established.

requirements.requirement: Develop reusable capabilities in their owning packages while preserving exact semantics and existing scientific evidence.
requirements.delivered: GPAC owns geometry/authoring/feedback; REMAG owns electronic/native diagnostics; research owns orchestration. Separate numerical observations retain exact sources.
requirements.outstanding: No new pristine calculation is required or authorized under the subsequent owner directive.

requirements.requirement: Avoid unnecessary process; prioritize concrete scientific capabilities.
requirements.delivered: Current audit separates mandatory implementation from examples, optional analysis paths and empirical outcomes.
requirements.outstanding: Do not prolong implementation with generic constraint expansion or speculative infrastructure.

requirements.requirement: Physics-informed structural interventions with parent relationships.
requirements.delivered: Exact axial, isotropic, fixed-volume tetragonal, site-displacement, selected-bond/coordination, orbit/species and motif operations.
requirements.outstanding: Local site operations explicitly lower to P1; no automatic maximal-symmetry inference is claimed.

requirements.requirement: Expose physical degrees of freedom, affected sites/orbits, coupled parameters and constraints.
requirements.delivered: Physical controls and exact parameter descriptions identify affected coordinates, periodic coupling, symmetry policies and admissibility.
requirements.outstanding: A general symbolic coupled-constraint solver is an extension, not an additional mandatory deliverable.

requirements.requirement: Associate relaxed observations with exact sources; compare displacements, symmetry, motifs and coordination.
requirements.delivered: Source-ID geometry import, atom/orbit motion, gained/lost periodic neighbors, authored Hall-operation residuals and accepted native relaxation feedback.
requirements.outstanding: Same presentation/origin required. Changed-count/cell matching and maximal symmetry are explicitly unsupported. Geometric motif survival does not imply chemical stability.

requirements.requirement: If approximate-to-exact recovery is implemented, expose its policy and residuals.
requirements.delivered: Observed floating geometry never silently replaces an exact program; explicit new exact hypotheses can use the normal authoring interface.
requirements.outstanding: Automatic rational recovery is not implemented and is conditional in the spec.

requirements.requirement: Experimental agent-native structural inspection, modification, motifs, constraints, comparison, lineage and validation.
requirements.delivered: Version-pinned GPAC JSON worker and persisted research candidates expose these operations without a public hosted service.
requirements.outstanding: Public deployment, release and model-service permissions are separate from this internal interface.

requirements.requirement: Informative geometric screening before DFT without universally rejecting novel structures.
requirements.delivered: Periodic distances, declared coordination/isolation rules, redundant translations, cell/complexity limits and family/reference-strain assessments.
requirements.outstanding: Policies are geometric advisories; chemistry-specific stability is not inferred.

requirements.requirement: Support local interventions and theory-guided novel authoring without a tetragonal restriction.
requirements.delivered: General Hall/orbit authoring, exact motifs/assembly, substitutions and retained parent/child sources; an uncalculated Fe2B source exercises general catalog handling.
requirements.outstanding: Realization and transfer of a learned electronic mechanism in new materials remain empirical long-term work.

requirements.requirement: Export k-resolved eigenvalues, eigenvectors/projections, occupations/weights and H/S/density information.
requirements.delivered: Native-bound H/S, spectra, selected-k eigenvectors and reconstructed density plus native density data; array artifacts retain units, orbital/site metadata, spin and frames.
requirements.outstanding: Selected-k matrix exports are bounded. Reconstructed density is not silently identified with a native density export.

requirements.requirement: Nonorthogonal atom/orbital DOS, spinor-resolved states and local orbital/spin moments.
requirements.delivered: Signed Mulliken populations/DOS, native spin moments and onsite orbital-moment contractions preserve overlap and occupation conventions.
requirements.outstanding: Onsite orbital moments and population partitions are basis/approximation dependent, not unique bulk decompositions.

requirements.requirement: Accessible SOC matrix elements and magnetization/convergence metadata.
requirements.delivered: Opt-in host and device-owned nonlocal SOC snapshots, spin-trace removal and checked state projections; native ownership tests and real-module Fortran compilation.
requirements.outstanding: Full CUDA-linked application and measured production SOC export have not been exercised. Existing scalar-only execution evidence cannot verify this path.

requirements.requirement: Inspect near-Fermi character, hybridization, directional spectra, band-energy changes, k contributions and orbital moments with explicit approximations.
requirements.delivered: Saved spectral comparisons, same-basis state/subspace association, Lowdin coupling blocks, native SOC projections, partial occupied band sums and onsite moment changes.
requirements.outstanding: No unique atom/orbital MAE attribution or cross-geometry tracked-band identity. Second-order perturbation analysis is conditional, not required for these delivered diagnostics.

requirements.requirement: Controlled finite-difference magnetic, electronic, energy and force responses to structural parameters.
requirements.delivered: Exact structural families, parent-atom selection transport, first/second derivatives, scalar/magnetic/spectral/moment/coupling/band-sum responses and conservative supplied-error propagation.
requirements.outstanding: Convergence/truncation uncertainty remains unknown unless measured; analytic/automatic differentiation is optional.

requirements.requirement: Selected orientations, angular anisotropy sweeps, branch tracking and appropriate coefficient fits.
requirements.delivered: Scalar/selected-direction/angular queries reuse native branch checks; at least three identifiable angles fit separate E/F offset+K1 sin2+K2 sin4 in a declared plane.
requirements.outstanding: Angular coefficients are one-plane fits. Numerical qualification is evidence-specific; optional force-theorem calculations are deferred.

requirements.requirement: Optimize useful end-to-end scientific queries; owner target is 1–5 minutes submission to usable result.
requirements.delivered: Query-specific stage selection, cache identity, saved calibration tools and controlled execution phase timings avoid automatically running all directions. Response calibration now accepts explicit original compact-archive manifests, retaining omitted bytes and source/workspace restrictions; saved same-tier identity control passes.
requirements.outstanding: No calibrated exploratory default or measured full-query target. Allocation startup/queue phases remain incomplete in archived measurements; no speedup is inferred.

requirements.requirement: Convert exact source, lattice, species/sites/orbits, magnetic annotations and provenance to REMAG input.
requirements.delivered: Verified physical exports retain source bytes/pins and a documented right-handed frame; prepared inputs bind source, pseudos and settings.
requirements.outstanding: Numerical conversion is binary64 and distinguished from exact identity.

requirements.requirement: Preserve authored/observed geometry and transformation/site correspondence, or report ambiguity.
requirements.delivered: Exact transformation results and source snapshots persist into candidates/queries; relaxation IDs, motion ties and supported presentation policies are explicit.
requirements.outstanding: Unmapped changed-count/cell observations are refused; no hidden proximity-based identity or maximal symmetry recognition.

requirements.requirement: Record revisions, executable/input/pseudo hashes, conversion policy, transformations, outputs and experiment history for replay.
requirements.delivered: Source/runtime/artifact verification, deterministic prepared bundles, matching-only cached reuse, immutable notebook history and separate numerical/program identity.
requirements.outstanding: Replay is supported where runtime/native artifacts are available; bitwise numerical reproduction is not universally guaranteed.

requirements.requirement: GPAC-authored L10 FePt with z/x/y SOC and E[x]-E[z] convention.
requirements.delivered: Existing measured FePt reports and archived source-bound directional outputs satisfy this finite demonstration.
requirements.outstanding: A directional difference is not fitted K1 or a physical-accuracy certificate.

requirements.requirement: Numerical qualification in mesh, basis, grid, smearing, SCF and magnetic consistency.
requirements.delivered: Finite controls and failures preserved; original DZP mesh and common-24 radial ladders pass only their scopes.
requirements.outstanding: Full qualification is unmet: common-24 basis and enlarged-basis mesh gates fail; combined/final controls not run. Campaign closed by owner; no restart or new pristine reference.

requirements.requirement: Controlled fixed-geometry FePt strain dataset with explicit path.
requirements.delivered: Fixed in-plane/c-axis strain families and existing measured perturbations; independent volume/shape controls and reusable exact series preparation.
requirements.outstanding: Suggested seven strain values are an example, not authorization for new computations. Dataset configurations must not be silently mixed.

requirements.requirement: Collect electronic, magnetic, force and convergence observations for strain configurations and compare responses.
requirements.delivered: Existing FePt native results plus saved spectral, projection, moment and coupling response demonstrations; six mechanism observables at three archived strain points.
requirements.outstanding: New isolated native SOC matrices are absent from the old full strain cohort; neither complete new-export coverage nor mechanism discrimination is established.

requirements.requirement: Competing physical hypotheses and targeted experiments that distinguish predictions.
requirements.delivered: Persistent hypotheses/alternatives, experiment rationale, immutable predictions and evidence-bound revisions; archived FePt hypothesis notebook exists.
requirements.outstanding: A verified discriminating mechanism has not been demonstrated; injected policies test operation, not scientific judgment.

requirements.requirement: Preregister held-out anisotropy/electronic predictions and compare simple regression/interpolation baselines.
requirements.delivered: Immutable response definitions, held-out grading and baseline evaluators. Historical prospective FePt controls and unchanged-model k32 transfer were evaluated.
requirements.outstanding: Original coarse quadratic predictions failed to beat scalar baselines; a later two-case additive model beat simple controls within its finite scope. Neither demonstrates a general autonomous physics advantage.

requirements.requirement: Agent selects inspections or calculations, records predictions first and executes the requested operation.
requirements.delivered: Existing policy runner retained. The current chat now discovers and invokes extensible local tools, selects an exact intervention, freezes a prediction and ingests source-bound saved evidence through durable call receipts.
requirements.outstanding: A known-data replay completed; independent matched scalar/physics study and production native acceptance remain. The user selected Astra extra-high; tool code does not change or attest chat model settings.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate predictions, revise hypotheses and retrieve reusable findings including failures.
requirements.delivered: Append-only hypotheses/predictions/outcomes/analyses, definition-bound scores, retrieval and failed/pending outcomes. A real chat-driven saved-data workflow persisted all five notebook event kinds and retrieved them across fresh processes.
requirements.outstanding: Software persistence does not establish physical truth or transferable knowledge.

requirements.requirement: Structured reusable tool contracts with explicit units/provenance and large arrays retained as artifacts.
requirements.delivered: Python, JSON worker and CLI interfaces reuse domain modules; bounded summaries reference hashed NPZ/native files. Direct single-call CLI, discoverable schemas, source-linked intent/result receipts and explicitly registered trusted extensions are now available. Response calibration now accepts explicit original compact-archive manifests, retaining omitted bytes and source/workspace restrictions; saved same-tier identity control passes.
requirements.outstanding: Native MCP installation is not required for shell-tool use and was not performed. Extension code is trusted, not sandboxed; scientific value validation stays in handlers.

requirements.requirement: Optional structure, cell, orbit, coordination, spin, bond, perturbation and authored/relaxed views.
requirements.delivered: General exact-source workspace and client controls consume structured numerical data while preserving authored source; Project14 styling retained.
requirements.outstanding: Browser visual acceptance is unverified because the earlier browser route was denied; protocol/DOM tests do not substitute for rendering.

requirements.requirement: Optional bands/DOS/spin/near-Fermi/SOC-related views and linked atom/orbit/motif/parameter/state/k/region diagnostics.
requirements.delivered: Saved bands, periodic regions, signed DOS/projections, spin and orbital diagnostics, selected structural families and linked responses.
requirements.outstanding: Paths follow saved energy ranks, not tracked band identities. Region-based immutable response targets are a useful extension, not required to inspect the selected region.

requirements.requirement: Working expansion foundation, eventually tested design-rule transfer and broader materials objectives.
requirements.delivered: General GPAC authoring, geometry screening, saved diagnostics and prepared REMAG queries support non-FePt structures.
requirements.outstanding: Fe2B mechanism realization, cross-material transfer, magnetic ordering, thermodynamic/dynamical stability, disorder robustness and synthesis plausibility remain downstream research.

requirements.requirement: Compare autonomous scalar and physics-guided agents under equivalent compute budgets.
requirements.delivered: Same policy/authoring tools, frozen inputs/held-outs, distinct observation profiles, equal declared ceilings, separate sessions and common grading.
requirements.outstanding: No actual paired autonomous comparison or measured equal GPU consumption has been demonstrated.

requirements.requirement: Error, response direction, electronic prediction quality, uncertainty calibration and transfer.
requirements.delivered: Definition-bound error/sign/interval scores, full missing/failed cohorts and paired errors; historical finite prediction/transfer evidence retained.
requirements.outstanding: Uncertainty calibration and broader transfer need independent observations, not additional score formulas.

requirements.requirement: Best independently validated anisotropy, magnetization, stability, distinct plausible candidates and robustness.
requirements.delivered: Complete authored cohorts and source-bound E/F/spin properties; exact candidate grouping under a declared origin/proper-axis policy; finite composition-conserving phase-energy and force/stress screens; preregistered structural-variation responses and magnetic branches. Missing/failed cases and their costs retained.
requirements.outstanding: Empirical independent discovery, complete thermodynamic/dynamical stability, saturation/ground-state status and global crystal canonicality are not established. The saved FePt robustness example uses retrospective thresholds. Finite reporting is implemented; scientific outcomes still need appropriate evidence.

requirements.requirement: GPU-hours, completed/failed experiments, validated candidates per compute and prediction improvement per compute.
requirements.delivered: Imported measured allocation intervals bind to saved reports and native time windows. Known acquisition, search, validation and grading costs are covered; hardware types and shared attribution retained. Candidate and prediction-improvement rates require supported positive denominators. Missing coverage remains unknown. Supplied phase, variation and numerical-refinement costs remain required when the candidate itself fails.
requirements.outstanding: No real provider usage was imported for the new paired comparison. Provider authentication, outside-usage completeness, equal empirical compute and invoices remain unverified. Reservations remain separate and unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Retain failures, numerical scope, correspondence/frames/reproducibility and prerecorded held-out evaluation.
requirements.delivered: Existing GPAC exact checks, native implementation references, source/runtime bindings, branch controls, evidence hashes and immutable research events.
requirements.outstanding: Current numerical failures remain failures. Existing verification replaces new pristine work under owner direction. Scientific truth is not inferred from protocol tests.

requirements.requirement: Audit, bridge, diagnostics, controlled dataset, autonomous testing, expansion foundation and optional interactive environment.
requirements.delivered: Implementation increments and their tests/saved demonstrations are linked below; original phase scope now maps to finite acceptance items.
requirements.outstanding: Direct chat tool use supersedes the separate API-account requirement. Independent empirical acceptance still needs its own finite evaluation/runtime scope; keep the convergence campaign closed.

final_deliverables.status: Integrated software and direct chat tool workflow demonstrated with saved evidence; scientific research quality remains empirical.
Implemented; new device SOC production validation pending.
Existing controlled dataset delivered with finite scope; full numerical qualification and new-SOC coverage unmet.
Chat-driven exact intervention, prediction, saved outcome and revision demonstrated with persistent receipts; independent paired study remains.
Software implemented: prediction/candidate/finite-stability/robustness and measured compute reports. Actual matched autonomous comparison and scientific advantage remain unproven.
Working general authoring foundation; downstream transfer not demonstrated.
Implemented and exercised with saved data; browser visual acceptance pending.

definition_of_success.requirement: Electronic/magnetic information sufficient to investigate anisotropy
Agent designs controlled experiments and testable predictions
Predictions evaluated against independent REMAG calculations
Measurable scientific value beyond blind scalar hill climbing

next_work.action: Run the integrated policy on a genuinely held-out evaluation cohort and compare scalar/physics arms with measured costs. Existing exposed holdouts cannot be relabeled as unseen.
next_work.requires_owner_input: A genuine unexposed cohort and finite evaluation/runtime scope with measurable costs; this chat can provide decisions using the owner-selected model without a separate API account.

next_work.action: Exercise the complete native SOC export on the target runtime and measure calibrated exploratory queries from submission through usable result.
next_work.requires_owner_input: Separately scoped runtime access and compute authorization; the closed campaign is not reopened.

next_work.action: Verify rendered browser interaction when an allowed browser route is available.
next_work.requires_owner_input: Existing browser URL-policy denial must not be bypassed.

optional_extensions_not_blocking_initial: Regional immutable response targets beyond existing k-index targets
Cross-material discovery/stability/synthesis programs beyond the expansion foundation
